definitions.ask: Should a non-opening edit in a block-ID token (Backspace, typing inside an ID) show the reopen chip?
definitions.why: the chip is the app's existing quiet way to reopen this picker, and it never takes focus

choices.label: Show the existing reopen chip, as caret-only moves already do
Show nothing; the picker returns only by retyping the separator or a caret move

definitions.ask: Should the `^` active-task picker also open only on the edit that typed its `^`?
definitions.why: Bryan reported only the `@route:` menu; the `^` picker can opt in later without rework

choices.label: Change only the Block ID Picker; Backspace inside `^route:id` still reopens the `^` picker
The `^` picker follows the same rule; Backspace inside `^route:id` shows its chip
